rationale: The bid-ask spread of 111.8 bps (~$0.50) is exceptionally wide relative to the 5-minute ATR of $0.27, meaning the spread alone exceeds a full ATR and destroys any near-term edge in either direction before the trade can develop. Price is consolidating in a tight range just above the 5-minute VWAP ($44.42) and 9-EMA ($44.47), but remains far below the session VWAP ($47.23), suggesting sustained distribution with no clear short-term directional catalyst to justify absorbing the frictional cost. With no comparable historical setups and a structurally disadvantageous spread-to-ATR ratio, the risk-adjusted expected value is too close to zero to warrant a position.
